history.content:

I'll parse the entire text directly from the PDF, extract Rick Riordan titles and statuses, and create a DataFrame for inspection.

```python
import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]

riordan_idx = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.lower() == 'rick riordan']
records = []
for i in riordan_idx:
    title = lines[i-1] if i-1 >= 0 else 'UNKNOWN_TITLE'
    status = lines[i+3] if i+3 < len(lines) else 'UNKNOWN'
    records.append((title, status))

riordan_df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=['Title', 'Status'])
print("Detected Rick Riordan entries and statuses:\n")
print(riordan_df)
```

I'll compute the number of Rick Riordan books with status exactly "Checked Out" and list them.

```python
import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
riordan_idx = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.lower() == 'rick riordan']
records = []
for i in riordan_idx:
    title = lines[i-1] if i-1 >= 0 else 'UNKNOWN_TITLE'
    status = lines[i+3] if i+3 < len(lines) else 'UNKNOWN'
    records.append((title, status))

riordan_df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=['Title', 'Status'])
riordan_df['StatusLower'] = riordan_df['Status'].str.lower()
not_on_shelves_df = riordan_df[riordan_df['StatusLower'] == 'checked out']
print("Number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the shelves (counting only 'Checked Out'):", len(not_on_shelves_df))
print("\nTitles and their status:")
print(not_on_shelves_df[['Title', 'Status']])
```
